responsibility: Implements generic vectorization pattern recognition on GIMPLE statements before transformation. It scans loop or BB stmt_vec_info records, uses range and operand information to detect idioms that should be represented by replacement pattern statements or helper definition sequences, records those relationships in STMT_VINFO pattern metadata, and marks original scalar statements as part of wider vectorizable forms such as widenings, masks, reductions, and other target-relevant idioms that neighboring analysis and transform code will vectorize instead of the original scalar expression chain.
